A quick animation I made to test a new neat model I got. Hope you'll like it !

My one comment would be to be mindful of the ears. Obviously they will be more rigid while the character is actively listening, but you don't want to go too far away from your default floppiness.

Your major movements are good and the subtle movements for the body are good, but the head turn at 50-53 looks odd. The ears turn with the head as if they are solid pieces. It's a slow turn, but the tops of the ears will still be following the head, albeit a very subtle follow. This turn is also the only time the ears are moving in sync, which is the other reason this moment looks peculiar.

Other than that, this is a splended little piece of animation. All I have left to say is don't be afraid of your pauses. When you have a character examining their surroundings, depending on what they are looking at, there's going to be a lot of quick, subtle head and eye movements, but you're also going to have long pauses. And I mean long with two, maybe even three o's. Sometimes you have to really give your character enough time to really look at something / in a particular direction.
